execution_scope: same-meeting new-support prospective screen, not production/end-to-end or independent-meeting/training holdout
gold_access: evaluation only; no inference routing, triggering, stitching or output selection

quality_gates.repetition_detector: First normalized-character span with minimal period 1..8, at least eight copies and at least 32 characters, extended by complete copies. Same frozen criterion; detection is not an output-selection filter.

retention: all original parent and triggered child raw outputs/statuses; fixed reference denominator; never drop failures
